svg.text: pick the two schedules to compare (or click a point in A)
click a point = make it C · shift-click = make it R · hover = value
row = one start state (50) · column = one schedule (52)
filled cell = success · rows grouped by where R and C disagree
③ drag over rows = select those start states → A recomputes
④ click a row → C and D replay that start state
the table seen from above · R and C side by side, same moment
R: standing still, waiting for a new plan
C: moving, its plan is k steps old
dotted = what the policy saw (N px ago)
grey T = block · dashed T = goal · ● = pusher · solid = moves done · dashed = rest of the plan
← → step · hover a point = when planned
motion: grey = moving, red = jump · time →
current chunk: ○ camera picture → think → act
click = move time cursor (C follows) · hover a chunk = its plan in C · window = that path in C
